text.sba.barrage_clash: 러시 대결! 점프 키를 눌렀다 떼자!
text.sba.riding_flying_creature: 점프 키를 눌러 상승, 대시 키를 눌러 하강
text.sba.riding_road_roller: 바닥을 포장하려면 로드롤러에 콘크리트 가루를 투입하세요.
text.sba.bullets.revolver: 스너비 리볼버 및 콜트 리볼버에 사용된다.
item.sba.lucky_lipstick.desc: 잠들기 전 까지, 더 나은 거래를 할 수 있다.
item.sba.stand_arrow.usedUp: 힘을 다 한 화살. 운석으로 만들어졌다.
item.sba.stand_arrow.haveStand: 이미 스탠드를 가지고 있다. 스탠드 디스크로 빼낸 뒤 다시 사용하자.
item.sba.stand_arrow.acquireStand_2: 능력 목록 키를 눌러 스킬을 확인하자!
item.sba.stand_arrow.acquireVampire2: 소환 키로 공격 모드를 전환할 수 있다.
item.sba.stand_arrow.bowTip: 왼손들기를 하면, 활로 발사할 수 있다.
item.sba.stand_arrow.reroll2: 소모해 다른 스탠드를 얻을 수 있다.
item.sba.stand_arrow.noStandsInPool: 화살이 줄 수 있는 스탠드가 남아있지 않다!
item.sba.stand_arrow.KillerQueenEXPFail: 이 능력을 해금하기 위해 충분한 경험치를 가지고 있지 않다. (스탠드 레벨 %1$s 필요)
item.sba.worthy_arrow.info_2: 크리에이티브 모드로 쏘면, 스탠드/자질을 제거할 수도 있다.

instruction.sba.anubis_normal: 세번째 공격 - 공격을 두번 눌렀을 경우
instruction.sba.anubis_one: 세번째 공격 - 웅크리기를 한번 눌렀을 경우
instruction.sba.anubis_two: 세번째 공격 - 웅크리기를 두번 눌렀을 경우
ability.sba.ice_guard.desc: 방패와 같이 정면을 방어합니다. 보라색 방어 게이지가 전부 소진되면 일시적으로 사용이 불가능해집니다. 기화냉동법이 활성화되어있다면, 적에게 냉기를 부여할 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.aura_push.desc: 흡혈귀의 오오라를 전방으로 뿜어내어, 명중한 적들을 약간 밀쳐냅니다. 공중에서 사용한다면 사용할 때 약간 뒤로 밀려납니다.
ability.sba.invis_vamp.desc: 가만히 있는 동안 주변 환경에 녹아들어 완전히 투명해집니다.
ability.sba.deflection.desc: 일시적으로 대부분의 투사체들을 튕겨낼 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.ripper_eyes.desc: 블록을 관통 가능한, 막대한 피해와 출혈을 발생시키는 광선 공격을 준비합니다. 충전 중 방해받을 수 있습니다. 한번 더 사용하면, 즉시 좀 더 약한 버전의 투사체를 발사할 수 있습니다.
instruction.sba.passive_manhattan: 조종 모드를 켜거나, 기류 시야를 활성화 했을 때
ability.sba.punch.desc: 전방으로 펀치를 날립니다. 꾹 누르면 3연격까지 가능합니다.
ability.sba.guard.desc: 방패와 같이 정면을 방어합니다. 보라색 방어 게이지가 전부 소진되면 일시적으로 사용이 불가능해집니다.
ability.sba.barrage.desc: 적을 몰아치는 공격에 가둬두고, 마지막에 멀리 날려버립니다.
ability.sba.kick_barrage.desc: 피격중인 적의 공격을 멈추지 않는, 하지만 보다 빠르게 준비되는 러시입니다.
ability.sba.punch_fate.desc: 전방으로 펀치를 날립니다. 꾹 눌러 연속으로 공격할 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.toggle_brawl.desc: 공격과 상호작용이 특별한 능력으로 변경되는 격투 모드를 활성화 할 수 있습니다. 격투 모드를 사용중일 땐, 방어 게이지가 더욱 빨리 무력화시킬 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.cold_punch.desc: 격투 모드가 활성화된 동안 공격할 경우, 전방으로 적을 냉각시키는 주먹을 날립니다. 길게 누르면 연속해서 공격할 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.cold_guard.desc: 스탠드가 활성화 된 동안, 스탠드의 형상을 띈 얼음으로 스스로를 뒤덮습니다. 열과 냉기에 내성을 부여하며, 전방 180도의 공격을 상시 방어해주는 스탠드 방어 상태가 됩니다. 이 방어는 낙하 피해, 화염 피해, 햇빛 등 많은 피해로부터 보호해줍니다. 방어 게이지가 소진되면 슈트에 일시적으로 금이 갑니다.
ability.sba.freeze_cancel.desc: 직접 얼렸던 얼음들을 다시 녹입니다. 사용 시 스케이트도 같이 비활성화 됩니다.
ability.sba.ice_twister.desc: 바라보는 곳에 소형 눈보라를 생성합니다. 바닥을 달라붙은 얼음으로 얼려 적을 구속시키며, 소용돌이 안에 서있으면 점점 냉각됩니다.
ability.sba.gently_weeps.desc: 막대한 양의 스탠드 파워를 사용해 주변을 섭씨 -215도까지 냉각해 주변의 공기를 얼립니다. 반경 내에 들어온 것을 빠른 속도로 얼립니다. 피로 덮이지 않는 한, 여러 투사체들을 튕겨냅니다.
ability.sba.ice_wall.desc: 얼음으로 된 벽을 지면에서부터 솟아오르게 합니다. 앞에 생성하면 몬스터와 투사체를 막아주고, 아래에 생성하면 벽과 같이 올라갑니다. 생성된 블록들을 충분한 힘으로 공격하면 파괴할 수 있습니다. 얼음 벽의 일부를 부숴, 타고 올라가는 식으로 응용이 가능합니다.
ability.sba.ice_wall_behind.desc: 얼음으로 된 벽을, 후방의 지면에서부터 솟아오르게 합니다. 스케이트를 타는 동안 대시를 대체하며, 스케이트 중 당신을 뒤따라오는 자들을 방해하기 좋습니다.
ability.sba.skate_activate.desc: 슈트에 스케이트 날을 생성해, 미끄러지듯 이동하게 됩니다. 오르막을 올라가면 가속이 줄고, 반대로 내리막을 내려가면 더욱 가속합니다. 스케이트 도중에는 다른 사람들이 빠르게 미끄러져 뒤따라올 수 있는 얼음을 남기므로, 다른 능력들을 사용해 발을 묶을 필요가 있습니다. 이동 중, 차가운 발걸음 인챈트와 비슷한 방식으로 물을 얼릴 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.block_freeze.desc: 무엇이든 얼릴 수 있는 능력을 사용해, 몇가지 블록들을 얼릴 수 있습니다. 언 블록들은 빠르게 부서지므로, 흑요석 등을 빠르게 부술 수 있습니다. 블록은 얼어붙은 상태로 드롭되어 독특한 건축 블록으로 사용할 수도 있습니다. 얼어붙은 블록들은 부싯돌과 부시를 사용해 다시 녹일 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.full_accel.desc: 스케이트 상태에서 최대한으로 가속한다면, 마지막 스킬칸의 경계가 노랗게 바뀝니다. 이 상태에서 점프를 하면 묘기를 부리며, 약간 더 멀리 뛸 수 있습니다. 이 상태에서 공격을 할 경우, 치명타로 들어가며 적을 상당히 밀어냅니다.
ability.sba.cold_blast.desc: 격투 모드가 활성화된 동안, 상호작용 키를 누르면 냉기를 모을 수 있습니다. 냉기를 전부 모은 후 상호작용 키를 떼면 냉기를 발사해 주위의 블록을 스탠드 얼음으로 얼리며, 몬스터에게 적중시키면 냉각시킵니다.
ability.sba.sweep_kick.desc: 전방으로 짧은 범위에 발차기를 날립니다. 명중한 적을 크게 밀칩니다. 공중에서 사용 시, 대신 바닥으로 강하게 내리꽂히는 공격을 하며, 적중당한 적을 잠시 기절시킵니다.
ability.sba.hair_grab.desc: 머리카락을 사용해 전방의 몬스터를 당신 앞으로 끌어옵니다.
ability.sba.hair_spikes.desc: 약간의 딜레이 후, 머리카락으로 된 가시를 주변으로 뻗어 일정 범위 내의 적에게 피해를 입힙니다.
ability.sba.blood_clutch.desc: 약간의 딜레이 후, 전방으로 돌진합니다. 돌진 중 접촉한 적에게 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 흡혈가능할 경우에는 흡혈하며, 일부 몬스터는 죽였을 때 좀비 하수인으로 만들 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.ice_clutch.desc: 약간의 딜레이 후, 전방으로 돌진합니다. 돌진 중 접촉한 적에게 피해를 입힙니다. 얼릴 수 있는 적이라면, 적을 조금씩 얼려 느려지고 약하게 만듭니다. 완전히 얼어붙은 몬스터는 공격받았을 때 산산조각납니다. 흡혈귀 운명을 통해 해금해야합니다.
ability.sba.dodge_air.desc: 한순간 빠르게 움직일 수 있습니다. 점프와 함께 사용하면 더 멀리 움직일 수 있지만, 쿨타임이 길어집니다. 공중에서도 사용 가능하며, 그 경우 잠시 투명해집니다.
ability.sba.combo.desc: 능력들을 연속적으로 사용하면, 콤보 포인트를 쌓을 수 있습니다. 콤보 포인트는 경험치 바 위의 숫자로 확인할 수 있으며, 콤보 포인트가 쌓일수록 당신의 공격이 더 많은 피해를 줍니다.
ability.sba.forward_barrage.desc: 러시하는 동안, 당신의 스탠드가 앞으로 천천히 전진합니다.
ability.sba.disc_imprint.desc: 스탠드가 담기지 않은 스탠드 디스크를 사용해 현재 가진 스탠드를 제거하고 그 정보를 스탠드 디스크에 담을 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.disc_swap.desc: 스탠드가 담긴 스탠드 디스크를 사용해 스탠드를 교체할 수 있습니다. 경험치 등 어떠한 자원도 소모되지 않습니다.
ability.sba.impale.desc: 3레벨의 출혈을 부여하는 치명적인 공격을 준비합니다. 명중시키기 위해서는 근거리 내에 있어야합니다.
ability.sba.impale_blitz.desc: 3레벨의 출혈을 부여하는 치명적인 공격을 준비합니다. 명중시키기 위해서는 근거리 내에 있어야합니다. 준비 중 공격 키를 눌러 더 빠르게 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 경우 방패를 무력화 하는 빠른 어퍼컷을 날립니다.
ability.sba.block_grab.desc: 바라보고 있는 블록을 집어듭니다. 공격 키로 던지고, 방어 키로 회수할 수 있습니다. 블록이 단단할수록 더 강한 피해를 입힙니다. 서바이벌 모드 건축에 유용합니다.
ability.sba.item_grab.desc: 현재 들고 있는 아이템을 집어듭니다. 특별한 성능을 가지고 있는 아이템도 많습니다.
ability.sba.mob_grab.desc: 충분히 가까이에 있다면, 바라보고있는 동물이나 몬스터를 집어듭니다. 던지거나, 옮기거나, 상냥하게 내려놓을 수 있습니다. 웅크린 상태로 공격할 경우, 들고 있는 엔티티에게 명중합니다.
ability.sba.mob_grab_sp.desc: 충분히 가까이에 있다면, 바라보고있는 동물이나 몬스터를 집어듭니다. 던지거나, 옮기거나, 상냥하게 내려놓을 수 있습니다. 웅크린 상태로 공격할 경우, 들고 있는 엔티티에게 명중합니다. 육신의 싹을 제거할 수도 있습니다.
ability.sba.phase_grab.desc: 스탠드가 전방으로 날아가며, 철창이나 반 블록 등 틈이 있는 몇몇 블록들을 투과합니다. 멀리 떨어져있는 아이템을 집거나, 레버 혹은 문 등과 상호작용 가능합니다.
ability.sba.dodge.desc: 한순간 빠르게 움직일 수 있습니다. 점프와 함께 사용하면 더 멀리 움직일 수 있지만, 쿨타임이 길어집니다.
ability.sba.stand_leap.desc: 스탠드 파워를 사용해, 범위 내의 바라보는 블럭 위로 점프합니다. 수평 이동보다는 수직 이동에 특화되어있습니다.
ability.sba.stand_leap_rebound.desc: 도약 중 벽을 걷어차, 바라보는 방향으로 가속합니다.
ability.sba.fall_brace.desc: 스탠드 파워를 사용해 낙하 시의 충격을 흡수합니다. 높은 곳에서의 추락은 여전히 피해를 주겠지만, 확연히 적을 것입니다.
ability.sba.vault.desc: 모서리를 보고있는 상태에서 사용시, 스탠드가 팔을 뻗어 당신을 끌어올립니다.
ability.sba.time_stop.desc: 시간 그 자체를 멈추기 위해 준비한 뒤, 모든 것을 멈춰버리세요! 능력을 빨리 해제할 수록 쿨타임이 줄어들고, 멈춘 시간 속에서 한 행동들 또한 쿨타임에 영향을 줍니다.
ability.sba.time_stop_impulse.desc: 키를 두번 누를 필요 없이 즉시 시간을 멈춥니다. 다가오는 공격을 피하기 위한 비상 버튼 용도입니다.
ability.sba.scope.desc: 스타 플래티나의 눈을 사용해, 야간투시와 함께 3단계까지 시야를 확대합니다. 채굴 중이나 멀리 보는 데 유용합니다. 날아오는 몇몇 투사체를 잡을 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.star_finger.desc: 스타 플래티나의 손가락을 늘려 8 블록 거리까지 공격할 수 있습니다. 몬스터와 방패를 관통하며, 출혈을 부여합니다. 준비 중 공격키를 누르면, 열화된 버전의 공격을 즉시 날릴 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.inhale.desc: 스타 플래티나가 숨을 크게 들이마셔, 엔티티를 당신을 향해 끌어당깁니다. 땅에 떨어진 아이템과 경험치를 줍는 데 좋습니다.
ability.sba.final_punch.desc: 눌렀다 떼어 매우 강한 펀치를 날릴 수 있습니다. 오래 누를수록, 더 강해집니다.
ability.sba.final_kick.desc: 눌렀다 떼어 매우 강한 발차기를 날릴 수 있습니다. 오래 누를수록, 더 강해집니다.
ability.sba.assault.desc: 더 월드가 당신 앞으로 날아가며, 닿는 대상을 공격하고 출혈을 부여합니다. 날아가는 동안 잡기 키를 누르면 대신 닿는 블록을 집게 할 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.air_tanks.desc: 더 월드의 등에 있는 산소 탱크가, 당신이 물 속에서 더 오래 있을 수 있도록 합니다.
ability.sba.fog_sword.desc: 저스티스가 활성화된 동안 공격 쿨다운이 줄어들며, 더욱 빨리 블록을 부술 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.cast_fog.desc: 넓은 영역에 안개를 뿌려, 환각 블록들을 보이게 하고 시체를 일으켜 세워 조종할 수 있습니다. 안개 속에선 저스티스를 가지지 않은 플레이어의 시야가 제한됩니다.
ability.sba.fog_morph_2.desc: 다른 이들에게 주민으로 보이게 됩니다. 할인된 가격으로 거래를 할 수 있으며, 골렘들에게 보호받습니다.
ability.sba.fog_morph_3.desc: 다른 이들에게 좀비로 보이게 됩니다. 다른 좀비들이 당신을 무시하게 되지만, 주민들이 도망치고 골렘이 적대적이 됩니다.
ability.sba.fog_morph_4.desc: 다른 이들에게 스켈레톤으로 보이게 됩니다. 다른 스켈레톤들이 당신을 무시하게 되지만 늑대, 개, 골렘이 적대적이 됩니다.
ability.sba.fog_chain.desc: 출혈 상태인 상대를 당신이 바라보고 있는 블록을 향해 날립니다. 대부분의 적들이 가위, 글레이브의 충전 공격, 나이프, 철사 함정에 당하면 출혈 상태가 됩니다.
ability.sba.fog_blocks.desc: 환영 블록을 필요한 만큼 만들어낼 수 있습니다. 안개가 깔려있는 동안에만 보이며, 실체가 없습니다.
ability.sba.corpse_army.desc: 처형 도끼나 가위(무기)를 사용해 몬스터를 죽여 시체를 얻을 수 있고(저스티스 사용자 한정), 시체 가방을 사용하면 시체를 보관할 수 있습니다(비활성화 상태이며 최대 체력인 시체만 가방에 담을 수 있습니다). 안개 속에 있는 시체를 조정할 수 있습니다. 좀비, 스켈레톤, 크리퍼, 거미, 주민/우민, 그리고 팬텀을 시체로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 거미나 팬텀 시체와 상호작용하면 탑승할 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.zombie_corpse.desc: 좀비 시체는 좀비와 허스크로부터 얻을 수 있습니다. 활성화되면, 가장 기본적이고 균형잡힌 병사가 됩니다. 웅크린 상태로 상호작용하면 들고 있는 아이템을 쥐여주거나, 들고 있는 아이템을 교환할 수 있습니다. 이들은 조종 모드에서 상호작용으로 직접 지정한 곳에 쥐여진 블록을 설치할 수 있으며, 도구를 쥐여주면 같은 방식으로 블록을 부수게 명령할 수 있습니다. 쥐여진 아이템은 방어 관통 피해를 줍니다. 비활성화 상태인 동안 썩은 살점으로 회복시킬 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.villager_corpse.desc: 주민 시체는 주민, 마녀, 그리고 습격에 등장하는 다른 우민들로부터 얻을 수 있습니다. 좀비 시체와 비슷하지만 약간 더 빠르고 약하며, 아이템을 쥐여줄 수 없습니다. 이들의 강점은 투사체에 대한 피해량 감소로, 원거리 무기를 사용하는 적들에게 달려들 선봉대원으로 아주 적절합니다. 비활성화 상태인 동안 에메랄드로 회복시킬 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.creeper_corpse.desc: 크리퍼 시체는 크리퍼로부터 얻을 수 있습니다. 이들은 크리퍼와 똑같이 행동하므로, 사용에 약간의 주의를 요합니다. 하지만, 조종 모드에서 이들에게 상호작용을 하면 이들을 점화시킬 수 있습니다. 크리퍼 시체를 먼저 원하는 곳에 옮겨둔 뒤, 벽에 구멍을 뚫거나 아니면 채광에 사용할 수 있습니다. 비활성화 상태인 동안 화약으로 회복시킬 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.skeleton_corpse.desc: 스켈레톤 시체는 스켈레톤과 스트레이로부터 얻을 수 있습니다. 이들은 압도적인 사거리가 특징입니다. 강력하지는 않지만, 단체 사격으로 적들을 방해하고 밀어내는 데 특화되어있습니다. 다만, 당신과 다른 시체들 또한 이들의 화살에 맞을 수 있으므로 주의하세요. 따라서, 신장이 낮아 화살로 맞추기 어려운 거미 시체와 잘 어울립니다. 비활성화 상태인 동안 뼈다귀로 회복시킬 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.spider_corpse.desc: 거미 시체는 일반 거미로부터 얻을 수 있습니다. 이들은 매우 빨라서 맞추기 힘듭니다. 상호작용하면 탈 수 있으며, 이를 이용해 벽을 타고 오를 수 있으며, 음식을 먹거나 글레이브 공격을 충전하는 등의 행동을 하는 중에도 빠르게 움직일 수 있습니다. 비활성화 상태인 동안 거미 눈으로 회복시킬 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.phantom_corpse.desc: 팬텀 시체는 팬텀으로부터 얻을 수 있습니다. 느리게 상하로 움직이며 당신과 다른 높이에 있는 적들을 공격할 수 있지만, 체력이 매우 낮고 작살에 취약합니다. 이러한 특성으로 인해, 이들의 주요 사용처는 탈것입니다. 오버월드의 밤 시간대에 한정해서, 이들은 날아다닐 수 있습니다. 점프 키를 눌러 상승하고, 대시 키를 눌러 하강할 수 있습니다. 비활성화 상태인 동안 팬텀 막으로 회복시킬 수 있습니다.
ability.sba.fog_clones.desc: Create fake mirages of yourself. If you are attacked, perhaps it was one of the mirages that was attacked, not you...
ability.sba.tactics.desc: Highlight corpses, and change settings of highlighted corpses.
ability.sba.fog_pilot.desc: Switch to the perspective of Justice, and fly around the foggy sky. On top of surveying the area, you can command corpses from above to move around (use key) and attack (attack key) your targets, after highlighting the target you are mousing over (attack key). Interact with creeper corpses you control to blow them up. If you give a zombie corpse an item by sneaking and interacting, they can use tools to mine and place blocks they are holding with the attack key in this mode. Press again to return to your body.
ability.sba.red_lash.desc: Uses Red Bind's flame rope offensively to lash opponents, has increased reach! Hold it down for a 3 hit-combo!
ability.sba.flame_kick.desc: Hold and release to throw a super powerful kick! The longer you hold it down, the stronger it is. Once it charges fully, it releases automatically. Releasing it early throws a punch instead.
ability.sba.fireball_barrage.desc: Rapidly shoots a sequence of fireballs that knock enemies back with an explosive force, can start stand fires where they land.
ability.sba.flamethrower.desc: A stream of fire that can damage multiple targets at once, setting them on stand fire.
ability.sba.furnace.desc: Adds a button in the menus of furnace type blocks (furnace, blast furnace, and smoker). Pressing this button lights up the furnace with the stand's flames.
ability.sba.red_bind.desc: Winds up a lasso ability, you have to get within close range to land it. It allows you to walk mobs around as if pulling them with a lead. Attacking causes the target to rise up and be held in place for a few seconds or until hit, while blocking or pressing the button again cancels it.
ability.sba.flame_creation.desc: Places stand fire down where you are looking. Stand Fire spreads like normal fire, but does armor piercing damage like other stand abilities, and only stand users can see it. It is capable of burning upside down as well, and produces no smoke.
ability.sba.life_detector.desc: Creates a life detector made of flames, which can be pushed along. Within a 15 meter/block radius, highlights all mobs nearby.
ability.sba.crossfire.desc: Begins charging a powerful ankh made of flames, which gains more power, knockback, and flame spread as it grows. Press again to shoot the ankh out.
ability.sba.crossfire_block.desc: If holding a block and charging a crossfire hurricane, this ability becomes available. Conceals the hurricane in a floating block, and if an enemy close by hits it, it explodes on them alone.
ability.sba.crossfire_ground.desc: If charging a crossfire hurricane, this ability becomes available. Buries the hurricane in the ground, it will seek out and explode your last target.
ability.sba.crossfire_special.desc: Creates a ring of stand fire around you, as well as four medium-sized crossfire hurricane ankhs which circle around you. Press again repeatedly to shoot out those ankhs.
ability.sba.flame_extinguish.desc: Snap away all stand fire you created at once.
ability.sba.projectile_burn.desc: Burns away incoming projectiles, and ignites incoming gasoline projectiles. Destroys flesh buds.
ability.sba.crossfire_firestorm.desc: Creates a large ankh which scatters tiny flames everywhere, increasing the power of your standard crossfire hurricanes and allowing you to use them in rain. The massive toll on stand energy, however, increases their cooldowns. This does not enhance hurricane special.
ability.sba.fire_slam.desc: Launches Magician's Red forward, turning it into a ball of fire. It collides with extreme force and lots of flames, but in doing so your stand is sealed for a while. Only use as a last resort.
ability.sba.self_burn.desc: If you are cold because of certain abilities, you will gain the ability to light yourself on stand fire to counteract the cold. Normal stand fire damage applies.
ability.sba.spike_attack_mode.desc: Lets you press or hold the attack key to launch a spike attack, pulling mobs in with a damaging attack that inflicts bleed. If interact is held, it pushes them away instead. This mode runs on a meter that must be full to use the ability, and recharges when not using it. Goes through walls.
ability.sba.heel_plant.desc: Extends your heel spikes into the ground, allowing you to resist most forms of knockback and walk on walls. Gives you a step height increase in both directions. Disables some abilities while active, deactivates when airborne or pressed again. It is canceled after enough enemy hits.
ability.sba.wall_walk_move.desc: Latches onto walls, allowing you to walk on them. Trigger by facing a wall while having your heels planted, or by being in the air.
ability.sba.firm_swing.desc: Makes all attacks critical attacks while your heel is planted, due to the increased force from a sturdy stance.
ability.sba.fall_disperse.desc: Halves incoming fall damage, spreading the impact across your heels.
ability.sba.corner_cut.desc: Enable this to skip the process of direction adjustment when running off a wall to cut corners. Also inhibits accidental jumps and lowers speed. Think of it as training wheels.
ability.sba.steal_memories.desc: After a mob breaks your currently set rule, allows you to turn a memory of theirs into a chess piece. Interacting reads the memory type. This ability generally makes mobs forget what they are doing, losing aggro on you. but it can also do other things like make villagers forget reputation, flip golem types, remove illager learned hatred, and make witches forget good and bad potions.
ability.sba.save_location.desc: Saves your current location into a chess piece. Using the piece creates particles that fly in the direction of the saved location. You can give these pieces to other people to help them find places, or just use them yourself to keep track of locations.
ability.sba.steal_memories_2.desc: If possible, this variation of memory steal takes experience away from mobs, and using the chess piece will give it to you. This is useful for taking experience from mobs without killing them. On villagers, instead saves their workplaces. On players, saves their bed locations. Using the pieces leads you to the locations.
ability.sba.step_shadow.desc: If someone you stole the memory of steps into your shadow (touching you without low light levels), any memories taken are returned to them from your inventory.
ability.sba.forbid_rule.desc: Forbid people from stepping on the block you activate this skill on. If you step on the block, the rule is undone by a lack of fairness.
ability.sba.piece_attack.desc: If you attack while holding stolen memories, you can hurt the people they belong to remotely, and even inflict bleed. However, the pieces lose this ability if their targets are not around.
ability.sba.leave_rule.desc: Bind yourself to someone. If they leave your side and go far enough, they break this rule. Animals and villagers follow you automatically when tethered so you can use this to move them around. If you take certain movement actions, the rule is undone by a lack of fairness.
ability.sba.hurt_rule.desc: Forbid people from hurting you while you are in the cowering stance this ability triggers. Stealing memories after using this mysteriously fixes resulting injuries, leg or otherwise? If you attack an opponent, the rule is undone by a lack of fairness.
ability.sba.exp_bishop.desc: Creates a special chess piece that stores experience. Attacking stores up to 10 levels of exp (1 while holding shift), and using returns up to 10 levels to you (1 while holding shift).
ability.sba.rule_change.desc: Changes the rule you currently are using. Essentially, cycles between the forbid/hurt/leave rules.
ability.sba.sleep.desc: Your stand becomes a special bed that doesn't save your spawn point. Only works in worlds where sleeping is possible. You can also use this ability to make your stand a temporary platform.
ability.sba.visage_creation.desc: Allows you to use experience levels to create any visage you like, or to create lucky lipstick. NPCs with this stand may charge emeralds instead.
ability.sba.face_removal.desc: Launches an attack that inflicts bleed and faceless, an effect that softens enemies up for attacks and makes some mobs self-conscious. Subsequent hits of this attack increase the effect level.
ability.sba.visages.desc: Faces of iconic characters that you can create. Equip in the power inventory (this menu). The mask slot changes appearance, and the voice slot may add voice lines depending on the visage.
ability.sba.lucky_lipstick.desc: Apply every 3 minutes, before the effect runs out, and you will be glowing with beauty, capturing love. Villagers will trade better with you. Apply until you sleep or drink milk, or something bad may happen...
ability.sba.encasement_strike.desc: Hold and release to throw a powerful kick! If you fully charge it, it becomes less damaging punch, but encases the target in a bubble and makes them float away.
ability.sba.bubble_barrage.desc: Charges a bunch of punches which do not directly damage opponents. Rather, they bury explosive bubbles into the ground which start moving towards recent attack targets, then pop out of the ground and fire at the targets.
ability.sba.bubble_selection.desc: Opens a selection screen to choose something to "take away" things. Changes all plunder bubbles you create after selecting from the screen. The screen gives detailed descriptions of every plunder type.
ability.sba.go_beyond.desc: Ends explosive spin mode to launch an imaginary bubble. It does not exist in this world, passing through mobs, blocks, time stop, shields, logic itself, and other things. It seeks out the target you are hovering over when you launch it, and cannot be stopped. It does massive damage and knockback, inflicting high bleed.
ability.sba.bubble_spread.desc: Spreads many plunder bubbles around you, taking away things on contact. If the spread exists, this ability instead pops the entire spread.
ability.sba.bubble_spread_redirect.desc: Redirects bubbles created from bubble spread towards the block or entity you are facing. Only applies to bubbles that have not yet taken things away.
ability.sba.plunder_bubble.desc: Creates a bubble that takes things away when it makes contact. Use bubble selection to choose what these things are. The bubble follows your cursor as it moves forward.
ability.sba.bubble_pop.desc: Pops all of your active bubbles. Applies to almost all bubble types, including shooting mode bubbles which deal knockback around them when popped.
ability.sba.bubble_redirect.desc: Redirects plunder bubbles that have already taken something away towards the block or entity you are facing.
ability.sba.item_launching_bubble.desc: Creates an explosive bubble that launches your held item. It drops the item and hurts on contact, but if you use the bubble pop skill manually, it launches the item towards whatever you are facing. Can be used for building.
ability.sba.bubble_scaffold.desc: Builds temporary blocks of bubbles towards the direction you are facing, moving your cursor changes its building direction as it builds. You can move more slowly over these blocks. But you can also climb them like a ladder, drop through them, and protect mobs that land on them from a lot of fall damage.
ability.sba.encasement_bubble.desc: Creates an encasement bubble. Players can right click encasement bubbles to become surrounded by them, increasing jump height as jump is held, removing fall damage, and providing immunity to certain things like Powder Snow or Air Pressure. Attacking with a sharp object or taking damage pops it. Can also touch non-player mobs to go over them as protection and can be sheared off.
ability.sba.shooting_mode.desc: Toggles shooting mode. You stop holding items, and instead you fire off explosive bubbles when you press the attack button. Once the red bar on the bottom reaches the top, you cannot shoot, and need to wait for it to decrease. Fill the blue bar by shooting to enter explosive spin mode where you temporarily can shoot infinitely and potentially fire off go beyond.
ability.sba.water_shield.desc: Uses up water in a held water bottle to shield you from many projectile types for a short while. If they make contact, they instead turn into explosive item bubbles which you can pop to launch back at foes. Also puts out fires on you.
ability.sba.plug_wound.desc: Restores a tiny amount of health and cures up to 1 level of bleed. Amidst this process, you are slowed.
ability.sba.danger_yap.desc: Hey Ya will watch out for mobs that target you, and bring them to your attention.
ability.sba.mining_yap.desc: Hey Ya will look for ores around you, and bring them to your attention.
ability.sba.yap_yap.desc: Hey Ya will cheer you on and make your day better!
ability.sba.chrono_vision.desc: Lets you see phantom clocks at the rewindable positions of entities. Their stream of time embers shows the direction the entity was facing.
ability.sba.rewind_time.desc: Rewinds time by 6 seconds, to the same positions that are visible if you choose to use Chrono Vision. It rewinds things such as positions, healths, and status of entities. It does not rewind everything about an entity, nor does it rewind blocks/items/cooldowns. But it can save your life and disorient your foes. Killing mobs/interfering with blocks distorts time, causing a longer cooldown.
ability.sba.watch_switch.desc: A physical manifestation of your mental switch to rewind time. Equips and cycles through watches. As it is physical, those without stands can see it.
ability.sba.clock.desc: Displays a clock when active, so you can know the time of day in applicable dimensions.
ability.sba.throw_bottle.desc: Throws a held water bottle directly from your inventory, it travels far and is good for activating the stand.
ability.sba.summon_survivor.desc: Place your stand down where you are looking, up to a certain range. When it is doused with water, it activates, and zaps the nerves of nearby mobs. This causes them to fight each other to the death. You can be zapped as well, locking you into a fight. When zapped, melee power increases, and you resist damage that is not melee.
ability.sba.desummon_survivor.desc: Every instance of your stand that you place down starts to disappear. This does not remove existing anger, so be careful what violence you choose to incite.
ability.sba.target_zap.desc: Lets you select which mobs fight each other! Enter selection mode, use your attack key to select an activated survivor, then one target, and then another. They will then fight! Press the ability key again to cancel or redo selection. While this mode is active, your survivors will not automatically zap mobs together.
ability.sba.stand_vision.desc: Allows you to see stands and ghost phenomenon passively. This ability applies even when using other powers, so long as you have a stand.
ability.sba.stand_passives.desc: Some stand abilities like passive fall damage reduction or furnace activation apply even when using other powers, so long as you have the corresponding stands equipped.
ability.sba.stand_summon.desc: Allows you to summon and use your stand, and all of its abilities seen in the stand disc tab.
ability.sba.invisivision.desc: Turn on and off the able to see see-through versions of blocks and entities that you turn invisible with your power. Turning it off is useful to get the perspective of someone without the stand, and to see through invisible blocks better.
ability.sba.invisiburst.desc: Release your emotions in a burst of invisibility, making you and all nearby entities invisible. It decreases your range of being seen, and wears off overtime, or when you do certain actions. Activating this ability briefly lets mobs see you. If the stand griefing gamerule is off, temporarily makes blocks that are not ores around you invisible too, which can assist in mining. Invisible blocks are without properties, and cannot be blown up.
ability.sba.controlled_burst.desc: A variation of Invisiburst with decreased range and no block invisibility. Signifies greater control of the user's emotions. Useful if you don't want to accidentally make your opponents invisible.
ability.sba.place_invis.desc: Place blocks, passing your invisibility duration down to them. Only works while you are invisible. To activate this skill, you must be holding a block and invisible.
ability.sba.ratt_scope.desc: Hold Ratt and scope in, allowing you to shoot while moving. Interacting builds charge, and punching releases it as a flurry of darts.
ability.sba.ratt_fire.desc: Shoots a volley of three darts, inflicting melt and disabling guard on the final hit.
ability.sba.ratt_mode_change.desc: Changes your manual firing mode between Single Fire and Burst Fire. Single Fire shoots one, stronger dart with greater knockback, damage, and melt duration.
ability.sba.ratt_place.desc: Place Ratt down, allowing Ratt to fire alongside you. Sneaking highlights ratt and displays the distance to you. Ratt is immune to being hit for a brief period upon being placed.
ability.sba.ratt_place_burst.desc: Shoot a burst of 3 darts from Ratt's position to your cursor.
ability.sba.ratt_auto.desc: Target an entity in sight and Ratt will automatically fire at it.
ability.sba.ratt_flesh.desc: Drops from melting creatures. Slows mobs and is difficult to break. However, having Ratt equipped bypasses these restrictions, allowing you to move freely and pick them up instantly by right-clicking.
ability.sba.ratt_bucket.desc: Buckets can pick up ratt flesh in a wide area, allowing you to quickly pick and place them down.
ability.sba.ratt_leap.desc: Launches Ratt in a direction, allowing you to quickly reposition them.
ability.sba.ratt_mining.desc: Locks Ratt to the block you are facing, causing it to automatically shoot in that direction indefinitely. In this mode, if griefing is enabled, it can melt blocks, making it gradually drill a hole.
ability.sba.anubis_attack.desc: Swing Anubis, dealing a sweeping attack. Goes through walls
ability.sba.anubis_sneak_attack.desc: Swipe lower, dealing more knockback and sending further. Different combinations of your first and second attack will result in a different third attack
ability.sba.anubis_pogo.desc: Dive forwards and swing your sword, breaking shield. Does not require your attacks to be off cooldown.
ability.sba.anubis_double_cut.desc: Swipe twice, launching targets away. Done by using normal attack twice
ability.sba.anubis_uppercut.desc: Swipe upwards, launching you and the target into the air. Holding sneak keeps you grounded. Done by using at least one crouching attack
ability.sba.anubis_thrust.desc: Stab forwards, bleeding and pulling in targets. Is more effective at the right distance. Done by using two sneak attacks.
ability.sba.anubis_quickdraw.desc: Wind up your sword, then lunge forwards with incredible speed, cutting everything in your path
ability.sba.anubis_shieldbreak.desc: Do a brief windup, then swipe in front of you. Does moderate knockback and breaks shields for a long time.
ability.sba.anubis_alluring_light.desc: Hypnotize all mobs near you, causing them to follow you for a while.
ability.sba.anubis_raging_light.desc: Force all mobs nearby to target you.
ability.sba.anubis_backflip.desc: Backflip to safety and can be done midair, restoring your pogo. Hold sneak to fastfall.
ability.sba.anubis_record.desc: Choose a slot and record a series of inputs. Pressing your hotbar keys lets you change the icon. The duration scales with your level
ability.sba.anubis_replay.desc: Choose a slot and replay the memories stored within.
ability.sba.anubis_mouse.desc: Using this while hovering on a memory slot will allow it to remember your mouse motions.
ability.sba.anubis_exp.desc: Due to Anubis' learning ability, you passively gain up to 50% more exp, even while Anubis is inactive
ability.sba.anubis_speed.desc: Anubis grants incredible athletic ability, allowing you to move much faster and jump higher than before
ability.sba.blood_drink.desc: Consume blood through your hands so long as you remain facing your target, damaging them to restore your blood. If a mob has drinkable blood, the indicator will appear in the middle of the screen. If a mob is not agitated, you can score a critical blood suck. Villagers and Illagers will zombify upon being killed by this skill, and can be controlled. You can also absorb held plants for direct health.
ability.sba.blood_drink_simple.desc: Consume blood so long as you remain facing your target, damaging them to restore your blood. If a mob has drinkable blood, the indicator will appear in the middle of the screen. If a mob is not agitated, you can score a critical blood suck.
ability.sba.vampire_passive.desc: You evaporate in sunlight. You run on blood instead of hunger, and eating raw foods and monster drops provide blood with no penalties. You cannot die of starvation. Drowning only lowers your speed. Iron Golems detest you, while zombies are neutral with your presence. You take decreased fall damage.
ability.sba.mass_heal.desc: Funnels all of your blood into health regeneration, temporarily slowing you down. This ability triggers automatically when you die, if possible, providing a last stand.
ability.sba.wall_walk_vamp.desc: Latches onto walls, allowing you to walk slowly on them. Trigger by facing a wall in the air. Press again while wall walking and facing another wall to switch walls, or to step onto ceilings.
ability.sba.vampire_vision.desc: While enabled, allows for passive dark vision as well as a longer jump height while jump is held. (The jump height skill indicates how high this currently is)
ability.sba.zombie_passive.desc: You are harmed by smite. Some potion effects are nullified or reversed: you are classified as undead.
ability.sba.zombie_passive_2.desc: Your strength, defense, and held jump height are increased. You can see in the dark.
ability.sba.zombie_disguise.desc: Activate or de-activate freely. If your disguise is on, you are treated normally by golems and targeted by zombies. However, many of your zombie abilities and properties are sealed to make the disguise convincing.
ability.sba.zombie_worm.desc: Killing enemies with blood suck gives you a zombiefish which you can then summon. Maxes at 5. Zombiefish target your attack target.
ability.sba.zombie_projectiles.desc: If you are holding knives, arrows, or knife bundles, you can sift them through your body and fire them off shotgun style.
ability.sba.zombie_enter.desc: Lets you mount just about any animal. Passively, so long as you are not disguised, you hide inside of animals you are mounted to and this lets you drive them past the sun so long as you do not attack/use items.
ability.sba.vamp_jump_boost.desc: Grants 3 meter jump height and 5 meters while sneaking. Hold down for the longer jumps, and tap for shorter ones. With the powers moveset active, grants %1$s meter jump height and %2$s meters while sneaking.
ability.sba.vamp_strength.desc: Exceed the limits of humanity. +%1$s percent damage for direct melee attacks against mobs, +%2$s against players.
ability.sba.vamp_dexterity.desc: Practice moving your limbs at unnatural speeds. +%1$s percent mining speed, +%2$s percent attack speed.
ability.sba.vamp_resilience.desc: Practice shifting your body to cushion against certain attack types. +%1$s percent reduced incoming melee damage, +%2$s percent reduced incoming damage from some projectiles.
ability.sba.hypnotism.desc: Turn on and off hypnotic pulses that cause nearby mobs to follow you. Hypnotized villagers do not alert for reputation changes when their blood is drained.
ability.sba.super_hearing.desc: Concentrate entirely on the sound of heartbeats, allowing you to find mobs through walls and estimate their health. %1$s block radius.
ability.sba.blood_speed.desc: A massive cheetah-like speed boost at the cost of half of your blood, allowing you to step up blocks as well. Speed increases by %1$s percent.
ability.sba.blood_speed.locked.desc: Use consumed life force to amplify your speed...
ability.sba.grafting.desc: When killed by vampires, certain mobs drop parts which can be applied to your zombie minions through interaction with this upgrade. Changes their properties and/or grants new abilities.
ability.sba.grafting.locked.desc: Give your undead army an upgrade...
ability.sba.flesh_bud.desc: Plants a flesh bud in the mob, making them attack your enemies (and never you). Some mobs need to be at low health first.
ability.sba.flesh_bud.locked.desc: Assert further control over most mobs...
ability.sba.sacrificial_dagger.desc: Instead of hurting you, sacrificial daggers now shoot out your blood as healing projectiles. It also puts living mobs under a special effect, and if they die under this effect they become vampire versions and fully heal. As a vampire, they are stronger but die in the sun- and drink blood of nearby mobs to heal.
ability.sba.sacrificial_dagger.locked.de: Your blood has special healing properties. Maybe you can use that to your advantage...
ability.sba.unleash_the_cold.desc: Grants vaporization freeze to the powers moveset. Power it up to make it better.
ability.sba.unleash_the_cold.locked.desc: You notice your body temperature is below that of a human. Can you make use of this unique property? (powers moveset)
ability.sba.eye_manipulation.desc: Grants space ripper stingy eyes to the powers moveset. Power it up to make it better.
ability.sba.eye_manipulation.locked.desc: As you practice your newfound body manipulation skills, you wonder what would happen if you manipulate your eye fluids. (powers moveset)
ability.sba.gd_punch_left.desc: Separate your main hand from your body, throwing it out to attack or mine with the item in your main hand! Use again to control its movement
ability.sba.gd_spin_left.desc: Causes your seperated main arm to spin in place, repeatedly attacking nearby entities. If the arm is in the air, knocks anything it hits upwards.
ability.sba.gd_punch_right.desc: Separate your Off hand from your body, throwing it out to attack or mine with the item in your off hand! Use again to control its movement
ability.sba.gd_spin_right.desc: Causes your seperated Off hand  to spin in place, repeatedly attacking nearby entities. If the arm is in the air, knocks anything it hits upwards.
ability.sba.gd_mold_leap.desc: Separates your torso and legs, and launches you in the direction you are looking, allowing for great horizontal moblity whilst letting you avoid fall damage. Leaves you crawling while your legs float back to you, damaging mobs they come into contact with and letting you walk again. Your legs automatically return after a time. Block to stop your legs from moving
ability.sba.gd_mold_field.desc: Entities in range of your mold will take heavy damage as they get lower. Entities killed in this way have a chance to drop their head. In addition, any entities that die in the mold will increase its range and duration. Eating food will cause the mold to disappear.
ability.sba.gd_stitch.desc: Stitches you up, recovering a tiny bit of health, and reducing bleed by 1 level
ability.sba.gd_pardon.desc: Select entities as allies, making them unaffected by your mold
ability.sba.gd_mold_spread.desc: Create a cloud of mold spores, affecting all entities caught in them with mold. These spores drift downwards, increasing in range until they hit the floor
ability.sba.kq_fast_kick.desc: charge a fast kick that [WIP], fully charge does a heavy punch with high knockback
ability.sba.kq_guard_bubble.desc: Uses Stray Cat Bubble's to protect you from attacks, increasing your guard
ability.sba.kq_config.desc: Config how primary bombs works, blocks destruction: explode blocks around the explosion; on contact: automatically explodes when contacting entities
ability.sba.kq_detonate.desc: Detonate the current primary bomb planted
ability.sba.kq_defuse.desc: Defuse the current primary bomb planted
ability.sba.kq_bomb_block.desc: Plants a bomb on the block you are facing
ability.sba.kq_bomb_item.desc: Plants a bomb on the item you are holding, the item is automatically throw on detonate
ability.sba.kq_bomb_mob.desc: Plants a bomb on the mob you are facing, it slows you a bit and has a big interruptable windup, but it will deal 40 damage on mobs and insta-kill players when detonating
ability.sba.kq_bomb_bubble.desc: Send a controllable air bubble bomb which goes in the direction that you are facing
ability.sba.kq_bomb_bubble_redirect.desc: Makes the current planted air bubble follow the entity you are facing until it gets out of you vision
ability.sba.kq_sha_summon.desc: Summons Sheer Heart Attack, it will target the hottest entity/block and explode it when contacting 'Look over here!'
ability.sba.kq_sha_throw.desc: Throws Sheer Heart Attack at the direction you are facing, it will target the hottest entity/block and explode it when contacting 'Nobody can escape Sheer Heart Attack'
ability.sba.kq_btd_mode.desc: Plants Bites the Dust in the Non stand user mob that you are facing, making ou unable to use killer queen afterwards
ability.sba.kq_btd_day.desc: Detonates Bites the Dust, everything restarts from the beginning of the day, the targets are fated to explode when the day reach the moment of ignition, stand is locked until you switch modes which save the targets from explosion
ability.sba.kq_btd_combat.desc: Detonates Bites the Dust, everything restarts from the last 20 seconds, the targets are fated to explode when the day reach the moment of ignition, stand is locked until you switch modes which save the targets from explosion
ability.sba.add_stray_cat.desc: Add tamed Stray Cat that you are looking or helding to your killer queen, letting you use stray cat related moves
ability.sba.obtain_btd.desc: Use stand arrow on yourself to unlock Bites the Dust moves.
ability.sba.meteor_shower.desc: Draws meteors from the sky towards you. They are small and cause no terrain damage but pass through blocks and hit anything in between. They inflict bleed and good damage.If shifting they will go towards your feet.
ability.sba.big_meteor.desc: Draws a single large meteor from the sky towards you. Does terrain damage as it comes your way. If used in conjunction with Stand Targeting, it creates a bigger blast that could be used to gradually mine down. They inflict bleed 2 and very heavy damage.
ability.sba.stand_targeting.desc: Your stand floats very quickly to the spot you are looking at, and buries itself in the ground upon summoning a meteor, so the meteor heads to the stand instead of the user. You can now make meteors mine a designated space on the ground instead of relying on weird angles onto your body. The downside is your body is no longer protected.
ability.sba.stand_retrieving.desc: Makes your stand come back, making it so that meteors go back to falling towards you
ability.sba.desintegration.desc: This Stand adjusts the angle of entry of countless meteorites floating in space towards its user, drawing them towards Earth. The meteorites burn up just before touching the user, so they can never hit it.
ability.sba.meteor_tracking.desc: Toggle between meteor tracking on/off. When meteor tracking is on all meteors in the meteor shower will follow you.
ability.sba.forced_dissintegration.desc: Makes all current big meteors disintegrate. This move is useful to avoid destruction.
ability.sba.grab.desc: When in stand targeting mode if anyone gets close enough to planet waves they will get grabbed.
ability.sba.manhattan_premise.desc: Manhattan Transfer absorbs projectiles shot at it. So if you aim a bow or a firearm at it, it will hold onto that projectile and use it for shooting mobs.
ability.sba.manual_shooting.desc: There are two shooting modes: auto and manual. In auto mode, the stand will automatically redirect projectiles it stores at the closest moving entity, so long as the mob is in range. The range is indicated with a brighter highlight. In manual mode, you have to enter control mode, aim, and press attack to shoot the stored projectile.
ability.sba.control_mode.desc: If you are not controlling the stand, it will always move forwards, and if you enter control mode you can override it's movement direction. If you don't press any key or go out of control mode, it will go to the last direction you inputted. It cannot move while holding a projectile.
ability.sba.wind_vision.desc: Lets you see your stand's wind reading from your perspective, giving you identical visuals to control mode. It is useful if the stand sees something you cannot from its position.
ability.sba.bonus_damage.desc: When the stand redirects a bullet or other select projectiles, stand damage is added to the projectile.
ability.sba.wind_reading.desc: The stand senses entities that are moving or have recently moved. When you control the stand or turn on Wind Vision, only those mobs are visible, glowing and highlighted. You also see your circumstances with a greenish filter.
ability.sba.manhattan_dodge.desc: Your stand gets a quick burst of speed. Ideal for dodging stand projectiles, which are one of your greatest weakness
ability.sba.diver_selection.desc: Opens an impairment wheel which you can apply effects onto yourself
ability.sba.diver_zip.desc: Your stand dives into the ground and zips you around! Control your direction using arrow keys
ability.sba.emperor_shoot.desc: Shoot a bullet from the emperor.
ability.sba.emperor_heat.desc: This takes over your experience bar. As you shoot the emperor, it ticks up, and once it is high enough you will not be able to shoot.
ability.sba.emperor_squint.desc: Slight zoom, not very pronounced, also slows you down a little.
ability.sba.emperor_single.desc: Shoot one shot every click, it takes a lower amount of heat.
ability.sba.emperor_triple.desc: Shoot three shots per click, it takes a higher amount of heat.
ability.sba.emperor_control_mode_on.desc: The bullets you fire home to your crosshair while turned on.
ability.sba.emperor_auto_mode_on.desc: The bullets you fire home to the closest mob to the bullet.
ability.sba.emperor_speed_up.desc: Your bullets speed up as you hold this ability. The faster a bullet goes, the more damage it does.
ability.sba.emperor_speed_down.desc: Your bullets slow down as you hold this ability. The slower a bullet goes, the less damage it does.
ability.sba.changing_stance.desc: Rotate between the 4 different stances, ground, neutral, knockback and redstone
ability.sba.ground_stance.desc: Redirect almost all attacks taken to nearby blocks, slowly breaking the blocks beneath you
ability.sba.neutral_stance.desc: Makes you immune to almost all attacks
ability.sba.knockback_stance.desc: Protects you from almost all attacks and make you take double the knockback of them
ability.sba.redstone_stance.desc: Redirects almost all attacks taken to nearby blocks as redstone signal that can be captured by observers, sculk, tnt, iron doors and redstone lamps
ability.sba.activate_invincibility.desc: Activates the chosen stance, you can't move, use items, place blocks, heal or attacks in this state

sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.sight.desc: Takes away eyesight from those who rely on vision after it pops, lasts a few seconds.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.sound.desc: Turns areas into sound-free zones, absorbs all sound and sound based attacks until it pops.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.friction.desc: Takes friction from the ground making it slippery. Can also take friction from a mob to make it slippery on any block
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.items.desc: Picks up items and brings them back to you.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.mobs.desc: Captures small mobs and brings them to you.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.oxygen.desc: Takes air out of the lungs of a mob, such that if they are underwater, they begin to drown. Also can drag oxygen from the air or magma blocks into the water to restore your own oxygen. Can also be used to put out fires, and take fires away from mobs, putting them elsewhere.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.moisture.desc: Captures liquids or gasoline, so they can easily be moved around. Can also move around blood that is on the ground.
Moves potion effects so they may be transferred between mobs or disappear entirely, attack the bubble without your stand to steal the effects.

config.sba.standGuardMultiplier.desc: Buff stand guard across the board if you're playing a harder modpack.

config.sba.standPunchCooldown.desc: The cooldown of the basic stand punch. once it recharges, your punch combo resets.
config.sba.finalStandPunchInStringCooldo: The cooldown of the last stand punch in the standard punch combo.
config.sba.finalPunchAndKickMinimumCoold: Abilities like Star Platinum and The World's Final Attack where you charge and release may use this cooldown, although many have their own separately. This is the minimum, charge time is also factored in.
config.sba.barrageRecoilCooldown.name: Barrage Recoil Cooldown

config.sba.jumpingDashCooldown.name: Jumping Dash Cooldown
config.sba.jumpingDashCooldown.desc: If you jump into a dash, you technically go further, so the cooldown increases by default.
config.sba.standJumpCooldown.name: Stand Jump Cooldown
config.sba.standJumpCooldown.desc: The cooldown for stand jumps/leaps. Only a few stands use it.
config.sba.standJumpAndDashShareCooldown: Stand jumps/leaps and dash share a cooldown by default for balance reasons against other stands with less mobility. Turning this off, however, makes them have separate cooldowns.

config.sba.bossesCannotLoseSight.desc: Boss type mobs will not lose eyesight if it is plundered from them.
config.sba.ticksBetweenSightStealsOnSame: The amount of ticks between stealing sight on the same mob or player. By default it is 300 ticks, or 15 seconds.
config.sba.sightStealingDurationOnMobsIn: The length of sight stealing on mobs. By default it is 200 ticks, or 10 seconds.
config.sba.sightStealingDurationOnPlayer: The length of sight stealing on players. By default it is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds.
config.sba.primaryPlunderBubbleLifespanI: How long all normal bubbles last before they pop. The default is 400 ticks, or 20 seconds.
config.sba.itemBubbleLifespanInTicks.des: How long item launching bubbles last before they pop.
config.sba.sizeOfMobBubbleMobsStolen.des: The max height of mobs that can be taken on a joy ride with mob plunder.
config.sba.widthOfMobBubbleMobsStolen.de: The max width of mobs that can be taken on a joy ride with mob plunder.
config.sba.maxExplosiveBubbleTravelDista: How far away an explosive bubble can go before it disintegrates automatically, by default after 30 blocks it goes away. This is valuable for clearing bubbles shot straight into the air.
config.sba.explosiveBubbleShootSpeedMult: A multiplier for how fast explosive bubbles travel when shot. Raise this to make them faster, lower this to make them slower.
config.sba.heatGainedPerShot.name: Heat Per Shot
config.sba.heatGainedPerShot.desc: The amount of heat gained per explosive bubble shot in shooting mode. The default is 2499 gained per shot. Lowering this could mean more bubbles shot in one continuous attack, the default allows 4 per burst.
config.sba.heatTickDownRate.name: Heat Tick Down Rate
config.sba.heatTickDownRate.desc: The amount of heat reduced per tick in shooting mode. Lower this to reload your bubble shooting faster. The default is 50 points per tick.
config.sba.heatTickDownPauseLength.name: Heat Pause Length
config.sba.heatTickDownPauseLength.desc: After shooting in shooting mode, pauses for 20 ticks (1 second) by default before the meter starts ticking down. If you want more continuous shots, lower this.
config.sba.explosiveSpinMeterGainedPerSh: The explosive spin meter gained per explosive bubble shot. If you increase this, you reach go beyond faster, and vice versa.
config.sba.explosiveSpinMeterGainedPerHi: The explosive spin meter gained per explosive bubble shot. If you increase this, you reach go beyond faster, and vice versa.
config.sba.explosiveSpinMeterTickDownRat: The meter that fills to put you in explosive spin mode slowly drains away passively. Decrease this if you only want the meter to build, not to drain. The default is 5 per tick.
config.sba.explosiveSpinModeTickDownRate: How fast the Explosive Spin ticks away, increase this to lose it faster when reached. The default is 100 per tick.
config.sba.goBeyondLifespanInTicks.name: Go Beyond Lifespan
config.sba.goBeyondLifespanInTicks.desc: How many ticks go beyond tries to chase its target until it fizzles out. By default it is 300 ticks, or 15 seconds.
config.sba.goBeyondTicksUntilItCanHit.de: The amount of ticks after launching go beyond before it can hit a mob. By default it is 26 ticks, or over a second. The reason this exists is to prevent walking into someone and then firing it point blank.
config.sba.waterShieldDurationInTicks.de: In ticks, how long the situational water shield lasts. By default it lasts for a full second, 20 ticks, which is essentially a very generous parry window.
config.sba.bubbleBarrageRecoilCooldown.d: The cooldown if your bubble barrage is interrupted. The default is 35 ticks, nearly 2 seconds.
config.sba.kickMinimumCooldown.name: Kick Minimum Cooldown
config.sba.kickMinimumCooldown.desc: The minimum cooldown of the kick attack, the rest of the cooldown is based on charge time. The default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.bubbleScaffoldingCooldown.des: The cooldown between creating bubble scaffold walkways. If you lower it too much, you can just loop it and walk across the sky forever. Thus, the default is 240 ticks. or 12 seconds.
config.sba.waterShieldCooldown.name: Water Shield Cooldown
config.sba.waterShieldCooldown.desc: The cooldown of the situational water shield ability, if you have a water bottle to use. The default is 40 ticks, or 2 seconds.
config.sba.waterShieldBucketCooldown.des: The cooldown of the situational water shield ability, if you have a bucket to use. The default is 40 ticks, or 2 seconds.
config.sba.woundPlugCooldown.name: Wound Plug Cooldown
config.sba.emperorShootingModePower.name: Bullet power
config.sba.emperorBulletRange.name: Bullet Range
config.sba.meteorsEmitParticles.name: Meteors Emit Particles
config.sba.meteorsEmitParticles.desc: If ancient meteors emit particles when touching an impact mound.
config.sba.punchImpactSize.name: Punch Impact Size
config.sba.punchImpactSize.desc: The size of punch impact particles.
config.sba.punchImpactOpacity.name: Punch Impact Opacity
config.sba.punchImpactOpacity.desc: How see through punch impact particles are.
config.sba.abilityIconHudX.name: Ability Icon Hud X
config.sba.abilityIconHudX.desc: The X position of the ability icons that slide in when your stand/powers are active.
config.sba.abilityIconHudY.name: Ability Icon Hud Y
config.sba.abilityIconHudY.desc: The Y position of the ability icons that slide in when your stand/powers are active.
config.sba.abilityIconHudIsAnimated.name: Ability Icons Animated
config.sba.abilityIconHudIsAnimated.desc: Whether or not of the ability icons that slide in when your stand/powers are active actually slide, or just jump immediately to the spot.
config.sba.itemBubbleShotCooldown.name: Item Bubble Cooldown
config.sba.itemBubbleShotCooldown.desc: The time between creating explosive item bubbles in shooting mode.
config.sba.itemBubblePopCooldown.name: Item Pop Cooldown
config.sba.itemBubblePopCooldown.desc: The delay between popping explosive bubbles in shooting mode.
config.sba.itemBubblePopShotCooldown.des: After popping item bubbles, puts the creation on CD.
config.sba.basicBubbleShotCooldown.name: Basic Bubble Cooldown
config.sba.basicBubbleShotCooldown.desc: The time between creating normal bubbles. The default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.encasementBubbleCreateCooldow: The time between creating encasement bubbles. The default is 80, or 4 seconds.
config.sba.vampireGuardPoints.name: Guard Points
config.sba.vampireGuardPoints.desc: How much raw, unreduced damage can blocking take take before its guard breaks?
config.sba.whiteAlbumGuardPoints.name: Guard Points
config.sba.whiteAlbumGuardPoints.desc: How much raw, unreduced damage can the stand take before its guard breaks?
config.sba.whiteAlbumAccelerationAmountv: How much speed is gained per acceleration build tick? The default caps you off at just beneath the maximum wild horse speed.
config.sba.whiteAlbumMaxAcceleration.des: How many ticks of building speed? 100 ticks = 5 seconds of uninterrupted running.
config.sba.sunArmorDamage.name: Sun Armor Damage
config.sba.sunArmorDamage.desc: White Album's suit lets vampires temporarily exist under the sun. Lower this to make it last longer, or raise it very high to make the suit shatter under sunlight immediately.
config.sba.blockFreezeRadius.name: Block Freeze Radius
config.sba.blockFreezeRadius.desc: What is the radius of blocks that white album can convert into frozen blocks with its frozen world ability?
config.sba.freezesSurfaceWater.name: Block Freeze Water
config.sba.freezesSurfaceWater.desc: Enable frozen world to coat the raging seas in ice.
config.sba.freezesGrassv2.name: Freezes Grass
config.sba.freezesGrassv2.desc: If disabled, white album won't replace grass and tallgrass, and other non-air blocks, even with stand griefing on.
config.sba.freezesSnow.name: Freezes Snow
config.sba.freezesSnow.desc: If disabled, white album won't replace snow.
config.sba.magicianAttackMultOnPlayers.d: How much damage the stand deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.magicianAttackMultOnMobs.name: Mob Damage Multiplier
config.sba.magicianAttackMultOnMobs.desc: How much damage the stand deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.magiciansRedGuardPoints.name: Guard Points
config.sba.magiciansRedGuardPoints.desc: How much raw, unreduced damage can the stand take before its guard breaks?
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierMagician: Adjust how fast the stand can mine.
config.sba.getMiningTierMagiciansRed.des: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.standFireOnPlayersMult.name: Player Stand Fire
config.sba.standFireOnPlayersMult.desc: How much damage stand fire deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.standFireOnMobsMult.name: Mob Stand Fire
config.sba.standFireOnMobsMult.desc: How much damage stand fire deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.maxMagiciansRedFlames.name: Maximum Flame Count
config.sba.maxMagiciansRedFlames.desc: The maximum amount of flames you can create. It is capped at 100 by default for server performance reasons, as the stand fire is a block entity.
The max distance you can be away from your flames before they dissapear. The default is 100 blocks.
config.sba.magiciansRedFurnaceTicks.name: Furnace Ticks
config.sba.magiciansRedFurnaceTicks.desc: The duration that you can set a furnace on fire for free, negative one disables it. by default it lasts 1100 ticks or 55 seconds.
config.sba.lifeTrackerManualPushing.name: Life Tracker Pushing
config.sba.lifeTrackerManualPushing.desc: Off by default, but lets you manually push the life tracker around instead of it staying in a fixed spot.
config.sba.magicianKickMinimumCooldown.d: The minimum cooldown of the kick attack, the rest of the cooldown is based on charge time. The default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.snapFireAwayCooldown.name: Snap Cooldown
config.sba.snapFireAwayCooldown.desc: The cooldown of snapping your fire away, the default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.igniteFireCooldown.name: Ignition Cooldown
config.sba.igniteFireCooldown.desc: The cooldown for the ignite ability which acts like a flint and steel, the default is 20 ticks or 1 second.
config.sba.lashCooldown.name: Lash Cooldown
config.sba.lashCooldown.desc: The cooldown before the lash attack string resets after doing the first two attacks, the default is 37 ticks, nearly two seconds.
config.sba.lastLashInStringCooldown.name: Last Lash Cooldown
config.sba.lastLashInStringCooldown.desc: The last lash attack in your normal attack string, by default the cooldown is 60 ticks or 3 seconds.
config.sba.redBindFailOrMissCooldown.des: The cooldown of Red Bind if it fizzles out or fails, or is interrupted. The default is 60 ticks, or 3 seconds.
The cooldown of Red Bind if you release it manually, the default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.redBindDazeAttackCooldown.des: If you left click during Red Bind to do a daze attack, it goes on this cooldown.
config.sba.ankhSuccessCooldown.name: Crossfire Cooldown
config.sba.ankhSuccessCooldown.desc: The cooldown for crossfire hurricane if it succeeds, default is 120 ticks, or 6 seconds.
config.sba.ankhConcealedCooldown.name: Concealed Cooldown
config.sba.ankhConcealedCooldown.desc: The cooldown for flame concealment in blocks, default is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds.
config.sba.ankhHiddenCooldown.name: Variation Cooldown
config.sba.ankhHiddenCooldown.desc: The cooldown for crossfire hurricane variation, default is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds.
config.sba.ankhFailCooldown.name: Ankh Failure Cooldown
config.sba.ankhFailCooldown.desc: If your ankh is extinguished or expires, it goes on this cooldown for a default of 80 ticks, or 4 seconds.
config.sba.hurricaneSpecialCooldown.name: Hurricane Special Cooldown
config.sba.hurricaneSpecialCooldown.desc: The cooldown for crossfire hurricane special, by default it is 600 ticks, or 30 seconds, because it is powerful.
config.sba.projectileBurnCooldown.name: Projectile Burn Cooldown
config.sba.projectileBurnCooldown.desc: The cooldown for projectile burn, by default it is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds.
config.sba.flameCrashCooldown.name: Flame Crash Cooldown
config.sba.flameCrashCooldown.desc: The cooldown for starting flame crash, regardless of its success. The default is 400 ticks, or 20 seconds.
config.sba.magiciansRedFireballsWindup.d: How long it takes to charge up the fireball barrage attack, in ticks.
config.sba.magiciansRedFlamethrowerWindu: How long it takes to charge up the flamethrower attack, in ticks.
config.sba.corpseDamageMultOnPlayers.des: How much damage the corpses deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.corpseDamageMultOnMobs.name: Mob Damage Multiplier
config.sba.corpseDamageMultOnMobs.desc: How much damage the corpses deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.villagerCorpseProjectileResil: Villager corpses take reduced damage by projectiles. The default is 0.5 (50 percent). If you increase it to one they take full damage, if you decrease it they take even less.
config.sba.fogAndPilotRange.name: Fog and Control Range
config.sba.fogAndPilotRange.desc: How far the fog extends, and how far you can control justice in control mode.
config.sba.maxCorpses.name: Max Corpses
config.sba.maxCorpses.desc: The amount of corpses you can activate at once. The default is 12, for balance in pvp reasons and server performance reasons. But in canon, according to JoJo 6251 (a guide written by Araki), Justice can control over a thousand corpses at once.
config.sba.standUserMobMinionCount.name: Enemy User Max Corpses
config.sba.standUserMobMinionCount.desc: The same as above, but for enemy stand users. By default it is 5 as to not overwhelm.
config.sba.corpsesUseOwnerTeam.name: Corpses Use Owner Team
config.sba.corpsesUseOwnerTeam.desc: Enables corpses sharing the scoreboard team of their owners.
Enables the ability for corpses to be given items by sneak right clicking them.
config.sba.zombieCorpsesCanMineAndPlaceB: Enables the ability for zombie corpses to mine and place blocks with their given items, if directed at a block in justice control mode.
config.sba.fogCloneCooldown.name: Fog Clone Cooldown
config.sba.fogCloneCooldown.desc: Change the cooldown of fog clone creation, by default the cooldown is 700 ticks (35 seconds) because the ability is extremely powerful defensively and lets you eat with little consequence.
config.sba.fogChainCooldown.name: Fog Chain Cooldown
config.sba.fogChainCooldown.desc: Change the cooldown of fog chains, by default the cooldown is 80 (4 seconds).
config.sba.phantomCorpseSpeed.name: Phantom Riding Speed
config.sba.phantomCorpseSpeed.desc: Change how fast the speed of phantom mounts are, it is 0.83 by default. Change to zero to disable the ability to ride phantom corpses in general.
config.sba.enableFogBlockInventory.name: Enable Fog Inventory
config.sba.enableFogBlockInventory.desc: Enables or disables the fog inventory skill. If the inventory is giving you trouble due to mod interactions or there are any other modded server issues with it, you can turn it off disabling it and its related code.
config.sba.attackSpeedBuff.name: Attack Speed Buff
config.sba.attackSpeedBuff.desc: Increases the speed of swinging weapons with justice active. By default, the stand increases your attack speed by 30%.
config.sba.miningSpeedBuff.name: Mining Speed Buff
config.sba.miningSpeedBuff.desc: Increases the speed of breaking blocks with justice active. By default, the stand increases your mining speed by 30%.
config.sba.miningSpeedBuffWhite.name: Mining Speed Buff
config.sba.miningSpeedBuffWhite.desc: Increases the speed of breaking blocks with white album active. By default, the stand increases your mining speed by 15%.
config.sba.bonusPlayerDMGWhite.name: Bonus Player Damage
config.sba.bonusMobDMGWhite.name: Bonus Mob Damage
config.sba.numberOfYapLines.name: Yap Line Count
config.sba.numberOfYapLines.desc: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.
config.sba.numberOfEvilYapLines.name: Evil Yap Line Count
config.sba.numberOfEvilYapLines.desc: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.
config.sba.numberOfMiningYapLines.name: Mine Line Count
config.sba.numberOfMiningYapLines.desc: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.
config.sba.numberOfEvilMiningYapLines.de: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.
config.sba.numberOfDangerYapLines.name: Danger Line Count
config.sba.numberOfDangerYapLines.desc: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.
config.sba.numberOfEvilDangerYapLines.de: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.
config.sba.detectedOreLightDuration.name: Ore Light Duration
config.sba.detectedOreLightDuration.desc: How long do the lights appear by ores? (200 ticks or 10 seconds by default)
config.sba.oreDetectionRadius.name: Ore Detection Radius
config.sba.oreDetectionRadius.desc: How many blocks away (default 20) can you detect ores?
config.sba.oreDetectionMaximum.name: Max Ores Detectable
config.sba.oreDetectionMaximum.desc: What's the maximum amount of ores (default 15) you can detect at once?
config.sba.oreDetectionCooldown.name: Ore Detection Cooldown
config.sba.oreDetectionCooldown.desc: What is the cooldown (default 300 ticks or 15 secodns) of detecting ores?
config.sba.yapCooldown.name: Encourage Cooldown
config.sba.yapCooldown.desc: What is the cooldown for cheering you on? (42 ticks or ~2 seconds by default)
config.sba.timeRewindOnlySavesAndLoadsOn: This setting is off by default, it makes time rewind only work on players. There might be a small marginal performance benefit from not saving past locations on entities in larger packs, so this ability is mostly for that.
config.sba.timeRewindCooldownv2.name: Rewind Cooldown
config.sba.timeRewindCooldownv2.desc: The time in between time rewinds. If you set it to 120 or less you can loop time infinitely like Ringo. But to prevent trolling and to make pve balanced, the default is 220 ticks (11 seconds).
config.sba.timeRewindCooldownExtraCondit: Additional ticks if you place and break blocks, or kill mobs before rewinding. This matters for balancing reasons because of how powerful this stand is in pve, and to limit pvp cheeses. Conceptually, since time rewind cannot rewind these things, you are altering time, default is 100 ticks (5 seconds).
config.sba.timeRewindCooldownUsesServerL: Let the server fully manage time rewind's cooldown. This is advisable because of the nature of the ability with bad TPS.
config.sba.chronoVisionRange.name: Chrono Vision Range
config.sba.chronoVisionRange.desc: The range at which Chrono Vision spawns particles to show the past locations of entities (50 by default).
config.sba.timeRewindRange.name: Rewind Range
config.sba.timeRewindRange.desc: The range of time rewind. It is not advisable to raise this too much for performance reasons. The default is 70 blocks.
config.sba.timeRewindStopsSuffocation.de: Prevent rewinding into a block, so you don't clip through anything or suffocate, or force anyone else you rewind to do the same. On by default. Rewinding time still rewinds their other aspects when this triggers, just not position related things.
config.sba.timeRewindStopsDeviousStrateg: Hinges on Anti-suffocate also being on, but additionally stops rewinding into cobwebs and lava. On by default.
config.sba.getMiningTierVampire.name: Mining Tier
config.sba.getMiningTierVampire.desc: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.diveAttackCooldown.name: Dive Cooldown
config.sba.diveAttackCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire powers dive attack.
config.sba.hairGrabCooldown.name: Hair Grab Cooldown
config.sba.hairGrabCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire hair grab.
config.sba.spikeAttackCooldown.name: Spike Attack Cooldown
config.sba.spikeAttackCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire hair spike attack.
config.sba.clutchCooldown.name: Clutch Cooldown
config.sba.clutchCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire clutch abilities.
config.sba.auraBlastCooldown.name: Aura Blast Cooldown
config.sba.auraBlastCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire dark aura blast.
config.sba.deflectionCooldown.name: Deflection Cooldown
config.sba.flowerHealCooldown.name: Flower Heal Cooldown
config.sba.bloodRegenCooldown.name: Blood Regen Cooldown
config.sba.bloodSpeedCooldown.name: Blood Speed Cooldown
config.sba.ripperEyesPartialCooldown.des: The cooldown of partially charged space ripper stingy eyes.
config.sba.ripperEyesMaxCooldown.name: Ripper Max Cooldown
config.sba.ripperEyesMaxCooldown.desc: The cooldown of fully charged space ripper stingy eyes.
config.sba.ripperEyesInterruptCooldown.d: The cooldown of interrupted space ripper stingy eyes.
config.sba.antiCheapShot.name: Anti Cheap Shot
config.sba.antiCheapShot.desc: Prevents using clutch moves right after daze moves. Otherwise, you can easily guarantee instakill progress.
config.sba.enableStoneMask.name: Enable Mask Vampires
config.sba.enableStoneMask.desc: If disabled, the stone mask can no longer make vampires.
config.sba.enableBloodVampirizing.name: Blood Vampires
config.sba.enableBloodVampirizing.desc: If disabled, vampire blood can no longer make players vampires.
config.sba.enableZombification.name: Zombification
config.sba.enableZombification.desc: If disabled, vampires and zombies can no longer make players zombies.
config.sba.SummonSurvivorCooldownV2.name: Summon Cooldown
config.sba.SummonSurvivorCooldownV2.desc: The cooldown between survivor stands being placed.
config.sba.SummonSurvivorCooldownCooldow: Let the server fully manage the cooldown of summoning survivors, so a lag spike doesn't lead to a hundred spawning at once.
config.sba.canonSurvivorHasNoRageCupid.d: DIO says Survivor is bad because it cannot discriminate between friend or foe, so in the spirit of that there is an option to disable rage cupid mode.
config.sba.rageCupidCooldown.name: Rage Cupid Cooldown
config.sba.rageCupidCooldown.desc: How long it takes for Rage Cupid to recharge.
config.sba.rageCupidCooldownCooldownUses: Let the server fully manage the cooldown of rage cupid, on by default because of how tps can affect mob AI.
config.sba.maxSurvivorsCount.name: Max Survivor Count
config.sba.maxSurvivorsCount.desc: The quantity of this stand that can be out at once. By default, you can summon 6 at once. Since they have a sizable range and need to be activated, it is usually not super valuable to have that many out at once.
config.sba.dryUpInNetherTicks.name: Nether Dry Up Ticks
config.sba.dryUpInNetherTicks.desc: How many ticks until Survivor dries up in The Nether? By default, it is 140 ticks, or 7 seconds.
config.sba.durationOfAggressiveAngerSett: This is how long those under Survivor's effect have the buffs and drawbacks. When they kill their targets, this status goes away. It is not connected to aggro (1200 ticks or one minute by default).
config.sba.speedMultiplierTowardsEnemy.d: By default, as mobs and players walk towards the target they are zapped to, they have increased speed. (1.2, or 20 percent more speed by default)
By default, as mobs and players walk away from the target they are zapped to, they suffer from reduced speed. (0.7, or 30 percent less speed by default)
config.sba.resilienceToNonMeleeAttacksWh: When zapped, mobs and players take reduced damage from all attacks, excluding melee. by (0.8, in other words 20 percent less by default)
When zapped, mobs and players deal this percentage more melee damage (1.20, in other words 20 percent more by default).
config.sba.bonusDamageWhenPunching.name: Increased Punching Damage
config.sba.bonusDamageWhenPunching.desc: Be like Westwood, when you are zapped you have increased increased punching strength while holding no items (3 damage default), but your punches also make you bleed. Note that this damage, although added to the base total in the same damage event, is calculated against armor separately, so it's not good for pvp.
config.sba.survivorRange.name: Base Range
config.sba.survivorRange.desc: The maximum distance from a survivor stand that a mob or player can be to get zapped on the stand's default mode (8 by default).
config.sba.survivorCupidRange.name: Cupid Survival Range
config.sba.survivorCupidRange.desc: The distance mobs can be from a highlighted survivor stand to get zapped in survival mode (8 by default).
config.sba.survivorCupidCreativeRange.de: The distance mobs can be from a highlighted survivor stand to get zapped in creative mode.
config.sba.canUseSurvivorOnBossesInSurvi: In survival, survivor does not work on bosses by default for balancing reasons.
config.sba.fallProtectionOnRelease.name: Release Fall Protection
config.sba.fallProtectionOnRelease.desc: When you exit a wall, grants fall immunity like a stand leap.
config.sba.enableWallWalking.name: Enable Wall Walking
config.sba.enableWallWalking.desc: Allows flipping directions to walk on walls. Generally, this feature is stable, but if you have a modpack that causes it to bug out/not work smoothly turn this off. Without wall walking, you gain an additional block of step height while your spikes are planted with walking heart.
config.sba.enableCornerCutting.name: Enable Corner Cutting
config.sba.enableCornerCutting.desc: Allows training wheel mode of Walking Heart by pressing V, so you can flip over corners.
config.sba.invisibilityPotionAsWell.name: Apply Invis Potion
config.sba.invisibilityPotionAsWell.desc: If you want the invisibility power to apply the potion effect as well, turn this on. This could be useful for map mods that respect players invisibility.
config.sba.hidesArmor.name: Hides Armor
config.sba.hidesArmor.desc: Makes the invisibility hide your armor. If turned off, impacts aggro range on top of literal visibility.
config.sba.hidesHeldItems.name: Hides Held Items
config.sba.hidesHeldItems.desc: Makes the invisibility hide the item you are holding.
config.sba.hidesPlacedBlocks.name: Hides Placed Blocks
config.sba.hidesPlacedBlocks.desc: Enables the ability to hide blocks if they are placed while invisible via skill key 3 (crouch input, unless you press the row switch button).
config.sba.hidesShotProjectiles.name: Hides Launched Items
config.sba.hidesShotProjectiles.desc: Makes the invisibility apply to items you throw, shoot, drop, etc.
config.sba.revealLocationWhenHurt.name: Damage Received Reveals Self
config.sba.revealLocationWhenHurt.desc: If damage is received from an entity removes your invisibility.
config.sba.revealLocationWhenDamaging.de: If damage is dealt to an entity removes your invisibility.
config.sba.revealLocationWhenFinishedEat: If finishing eating removes your invisibility.
config.sba.invisiBurstCooldown.name: Invisiburst Cooldown
config.sba.invisiBurstCooldown.desc: The amount of ticks in between turning invisible.

config.sba.oxygenTankAdditionalTicks.des: How many ticks of oxygen do you want saved in The World's tank? The default, 300, is 15 seconds worth of extra underwater breathing.
