config.sba.assaultInterruptCooldown.desc: If you are hit before assault connects, this cooldown is incurred. (default is 60 ticks or 3 seconds)
Star Platinum's Time Stop lasts 100 ticks (5 seconds, Jotaro's highest achieved length) at a full charge by default.
config.sba.maxTimeStopTicksTheWorld.name: Max TW Length in Ticks
config.sba.maxTimeStopTicksTheWorld.desc: The World's Time Stop only gets extra seconds if it is fully charged and fully leveled, so this is the basic maximum you charge (100 ticks). Keep in mind pressing time stop again early lets use activate the ability without a full charge.
config.sba.maxTWChargeBonusTicks.name: Full Charge TW Ticks
config.sba.maxTWChargeBonusTicks.desc: When Time stop is fully charged and The World is fully leveled, it gains an additional 4 seconds (80 ticks). This lets it reach 9 seconds, which Araki later confirmed to be DIO's true limit (as opposed to the 11 seconds DIO presumed).
config.sba.maxSPChargeBonusTicks.name: Full Charge SP Ticks
config.sba.maxSPChargeBonusTicks.desc: The same as the above but for Star Platinum. By default, the mod offers a different advantage for Star Platinum's full charge (see below), so this is not recommended.
config.sba.reducedTSDamageDealt.name: Reduced Damage Dealt
config.sba.reducedTSDamageDealt.desc: By default, all attacks deal 66 Percent damage in stopped time for balancing reasoning. If you change it to 100, all attacks deal full damage. If you change it to zero, you cannot attack directly.
config.sba.maxSPBypassesReduction.name: Max SP Bypass Reduction
config.sba.maxSPBypassesReduction.desc: When time stop is fully charged, Star Platinum bypasses damage reduction to deal full damage. This is an ability designed to at least somewhat rival extra seconds, as the cooldown for time stop is dependent on seconds used by default.
config.sba.maxTWBypassesReduction.name: Max TW Bypass Reduction
config.sba.maxTWBypassesReduction.desc: The same as the above, but for The World. The World definitely does not need this with its 9 second Time Stop.
config.sba.impulseTimeStopLength.name: Impulse Length
config.sba.impulseTimeStopLength.desc: The length of using the crouch variation of Time Stop. It is an ability designed to emulate pressing the Time Stop key twice, just for people with really fast reaction time. But some users may want this ability to be more relevant or dominant in battle.
config.sba.rateOfChargingTimeStop.name: Charging Rate
config.sba.rateOfChargingTimeStop.desc: How many ticks of time stop do you charge per ticks that pass by? You start a time stop charge with 20 ticks, so at the default rate of 2 ticks, charging time stop fully takes two seconds. But if you raise Time Stop's length at all, you may want to consider increasing this rate, or the charging animation will take forever.
config.sba.timeStopMinimumCooldown.name: Minimum Cooldown
config.sba.timeStopMinimumCooldown.desc: When you end a time stop, regardless of what happens, this cooldown will always apply. Note there are other factors below that go into the cooldown length. Default is 200, 10 seconds.
config.sba.additionalCooldownPerSecondsU: The longer you spend in stopped time, without ending it early, the longer the cooldown is by these ticks. By default it is set to 100, so after every second of spent time you have to wait five additional seconds. This is to incentivize ending the ability early for a shorter cooldown and to balance the power of time stop.
Doing any action like attacking, eating, or launching projectiles in stopped time raises the cooldown even further by this amount (300 ticks or 15 seconds by default) once. This is to encourage using time stop for movement instead of attacking and for balancing reasons.
config.sba.timeStopInterruptedCooldownv2: The cooldown for getting hit and having your time stop canceled. By default, it is 80 ticks (4 seconds). This cooldown exists both for balancing, and to incentivize pressing the time stop button again early to prevent getting hit out of time stop, decreasing your TS time when you do so.
config.sba.timeStopInterruptedCooldownMo: The cooldown for getting hit and having your time stop canceled. By default, it is 80 ticks (4 seconds). This cooldown exists both for balancing, and to incentivize pressing the time stop button again early to prevent getting hit out of time stop, decreasing your TS time when you do so.
config.sba.timeStopIsAlwaysInterruptable: Whether or not you can even be interrupted while charging time stop. By default this is set to true for balancing reasons, but if you just want to be powerful set this to false.
config.sba.preventsBreathing.name: Prevents Breathing
config.sba.preventsBreathing.desc: Whether or not Time Stop uses your oxygen as well. Technically, Araki said in an interview that The World's Tanks were used for breathing in stopped time, so this option is an impractical homage to that, and is off by default.
config.sba.enableHovering.name: Enable Hovering
config.sba.enableHovering.desc: When holding spacebar, you can hover in stopped time by default. This is because Time Stop halts gravity. Time and gravity are connected in JoJo, and so DIO is shown hovering while time is stopped. Jotaro even hovers a bit in Part 4.
config.sba.enableCarryingWhileHovering.d: When you hover, drops targets that you grabbed. This is to prevent excessive fall damage tricks.
config.sba.mobsTeleportInsteadOfStopping: Mobs using The World teleport instead of truly stopping time. This is on by default because getting stopped by simple mob ai does not feel great from a gameplay perspective, nor is it fair for a creeper to do so. But if you want that to happen...
config.sba.wardenMovesInStoppedTime.name: Warden Can Move
config.sba.wardenMovesInStoppedTime.desc: The Warden can bypass stopped time, because it is a supernatural entity with special properties.
The maximum percentage of a player's health you can reduce in stopped time. By default, it is 30 percent of their max health.
Creative players can stop time on a dime forever, this is useful as a tool for building, stopping griefing or fire spread, taking screenshots, etc.
config.sba.blockRangeNegativeOneIsInfini: By default the ability has an 100 block radius so only players nearby feel it. If you set it to -1, it becomes global and actually stops the time of day beyond just visually.
config.sba.postTSiframes.name: Invincibility Ticks
config.sba.postTSiframes.desc: The amount of ticks after taking time damage in which you are immune to damage. Default is 19.
config.sba.postTSSoften.name: Post Stop Soften
config.sba.postTSSoften.desc: Whether or not players take reduced damage from things beyond your control (gasoline, stand attacks) after a time stop ends. The duration is proportionate to how long they are stopped, and only applies for stops that last more than a second.
config.sba.postTSCancel.name: Post Stop Cancel
config.sba.postTSCancel.desc: Whether or not certain moves get canceled when time resumes. Disable for legacy version.

config.sba.timestopLeapCooldown.desc: Time stop is disabled for a short time after a leap
config.sba.starFingerLeapCooldown.name: Star Finger Leaping CD
config.sba.starFingerLeapCooldown.desc: Time stop is disabled for a short time after a leap

config.sba.timestopCancelsFood.desc: While in stopped time, you cannot gain healing from food

config.sba.expPerVampLevelUp.desc: Increase to make leveling take longer, decrease to make shorter.
config.sba.expTypeCapPerDay.name: Blood Experience Per Type
config.sba.expTypeCapPerDay.desc: Increase to let you get more blood exp from each mob type daily. it is kept low to prevent the need for massive animal farm hording.

config.sba.expInterval.desc: Change how many ticks between vampire leveling exp.
config.sba.canSurviveInRain.name: Rain Blocks Sunlight
config.sba.canSurviveInRain.desc: If you want to cheat the challenge of vampirism while it's raining, enable this.
config.sba.sunDamageUnderwaterReach.name: Underwater Sun Damage Reach
config.sba.sunDamageUnderwaterReach.desc: Change how far underwater sunlight reaches. Zero makes sunlight not intrude on water.
config.sba.drownSpeedModifier.name: Vampire Oxygen Swim Slowdown
config.sba.drownSpeedModifier.desc: When drowning, instead of taking damage, vampiric players are slowed down using this multiplier. Lower = slower.
config.sba.sunDamagePercentPerDamageTick: How much of your health is drained, percentage wise of max health, per hit under the sun as a vampiric player? If you set this to 0, you will be fully immune to sunlight. Be warned that removing this drawback just makes vampires objectively better, and not vampires.
config.sba.vampireUsesInternalSaturation: Set to false to make forge appleskin render golden meat sticks over blood bar.
config.sba.levelsToGetStand.name: Arrow Stand Level Cost
config.sba.levelsToGetStand.desc: Obtaining a stand from a Stand Arrow costs 15 levels by default.
By default, it costs 1 level to change the stand charged on a stand arrow. Keep in mind using the arrow on a mob also rerolls it (and uses 1 durability).
config.sba.canAwakenOtherPlayersWithArro: By default, shooting another player with a stand arrow does not awaken their stand to prevent forcing someone to be stuck with something bad.
config.sba.standArrowsHideResults.name: Arrows Hide Results
config.sba.standArrowsHideResults.desc: Enable to make the stand on an arrow a mystery. You may become "stuck" with a stand you don't like or waste extra levels on duplicates.
config.sba.classicGasoline.name: Classic Gasoline
config.sba.classicGasoline.desc: Turn on for gasoline to be super oppressive in pvp like it used to be.
config.sba.canThrowVisagesOntoOtherPlaye: Whether or not stand item throws with visages can apply the visages on players. Mostly exists for debug testing.
config.sba.standDiscsDropWithKeepGameRul: If the gamerule for losing stands on death is on, you instead drop your stand disc on death if this setting is enabled.
config.sba.locacacaEatingCooldowns.name: New Locacaca Cooldown
config.sba.locacacaEatingCooldowns.desc: The time between eating New Locacaca fruits, in ticks. By default, it takes roughly a minute in between, due to the powerful healing potential.
config.sba.knifeDamageOnMobs.name: Knife Mob Damage
config.sba.knifeDamageOnMobs.desc: A damage multiplier for knives hitting mobs. Knives do not bypass armor, but they do penetrate enchantments for the most part.
config.sba.gunDamageOnMobs.name: Gun Damage
config.sba.gunDamageOnMobs.desc: A damage multiplier for guns hitting mobs. Guns have higher dps than bows, but are still scaled to vanilla by default.
config.sba.knifeDamageOnPlayers.name: Knife Player Damage
config.sba.knifeDamageOnPlayers.desc: A damage multiplier for knives hitting players. Knives do not bypass armor, but they do penetrate enchantments for the most part.
config.sba.gunDamageOnPlayers.name: Gun Player Damage
config.sba.gunDamageOnPlayers.desc: A damage multiplier for guns hitting players. Guns are super fast, accurate, and have no windup. So it is not recommended to make them more powerful against players, they are mostly for inflicting bleed.
config.sba.rifleDamage.name: Rifle Damage
config.sba.rifleDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, how much damage does the rifle cap at?
config.sba.snubnoseDamage.name: Snubnose Damage
config.sba.snubnoseDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, the base snubnose damage. (it does +1 bonus damage if you hit while not on i-frames as well)
config.sba.coltDamage.name: Colt Damage
config.sba.coltDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, the base colt damage.
config.sba.tommyGunDamage.name: Tommy Gun Damage
config.sba.tommyGunDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, the base tommy gun damage.
config.sba.maxKnivesInOneHit.name: Max Knives In One Hit
config.sba.maxKnivesInOneHit.desc: The maximum amount of knives that can hit an entity at once. For instance, if you stop time and surround an entity with knife bundles, where is the limit?
config.sba.gasolineExplosionDamage.name: Gasoline Damage Multiplier
config.sba.gasolineExplosionDamage.desc: A damage multiplier for gasoline explosions.
config.sba.matchDamage.name: Match Damage Multiplier
config.sba.matchDamage.desc: A damage multiplier for thrown matches.
config.sba.switchStandDiscLength.name: Stand Disc Switch Length
config.sba.switchStandDiscLength.desc: The length of switching stands is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds by default.
config.sba.switchStandDiscWhileOnCooldow: The length of switching stands while already on an ability cooldown is increased to 300 ticks (15 seconds) by default.
config.sba.worthyMobOdds.name: Worthy Mob Chance
config.sba.worthyMobOdds.desc: Set the percentage of mobs that are worthy to have stands if shot with arrows. By default, it is 0.05, or 5 Percent of all mobs (1 in 20). 100 Percent would be 1.0.
config.sba.standUserOdds.name: Stand User Mob Chance
config.sba.standUserOdds.desc: Set the percentage of mobs that are natural stand users. By default, it is 0.005 or 0.5 Percent of all mobs (1 in 200). 100 Percent would be 1.0.
config.sba.standUserVillagerOdds.name: Stand User Villager Chance
config.sba.standUserVillagerOdds.desc: The chance of a Villager being a natural stand user. By default, it is 0.02, or 2 Percent of all Villagers (1 in 50).
config.sba.userAndWorthyBreedingOddsBonu: Bonus Percent chances of a worthy or stand user mob passing it down. By default, there is a 15 percent worthiness bonus passed per worthy parent, and a 15 percent natural stand user bonus passed on per stand user parent.
config.sba.multiplyAboveForVillagerBreed: Multiply the above number by 2x by default if the parents are villagers. This is truly the part 8 family experience.
config.sba.standUserMonstersDropMeteorit: Monsters who are natural stand users drop meteorite by default when killed by the player.
config.sba.bossMobsCanNaturallyHaveStand: Whether or not boss mobs also have a chance of being stand users. By default, it's a no, so you don't get cheated by an unfair fight.
config.sba.standUserMobsTakePlayerDamage: By default, stand user mobs take the player damage multipliers in the config instead of mob damage multipliers for balancing reasons. Changing this makes them take the full damage instead.
config.sba.percentOfZombieVillagersThatB: The percentage of zombie villagers that become zombie aestheticians instead.
config.sba.disableBleedingAndBloodSplatt: If you are sensitive to blood, this setting might help.
config.sba.CBHasDurability.name: Durability
config.sba.CBHasDurability.desc: Makes the stand have a block-like property, that means you can break their block and hit the user.
config.sba.CBDurability.name: Durability amount
config.sba.CBDurability.desc: Defines the amount of durability point 20cb has (durability needs to be turned on).

config.sba.enableCenturyBoy.desc: Turn the stand on or off. If off, the stand disc will not work or be in arrow/mob pools no matter what.
config.sba.oldKnockbackStance.name: Old knockback stance
config.sba.oldKnockbackStance.desc: Makes so that the damage received while in the knockback stance directly multiply the amount of knockback you take.
config.sba.buffedGroundStance.name: Buffed ground stance
config.sba.buffedGroundStance.desc: The current version of the ground stance makes some exceptions to what kinds of damage can be redirected, this config disables that.
config.sba.generalDetectionGoThroughDoor: Some of the mod's area of affect or line of sight mechanics stop when they hit a block, turning  this off lets you hit past corners and doors with certain things. Not recommended.

config.sba.powerSwitchingPenalty.name: Switching Penalty
config.sba.powerSwitchingPenalty.desc: A penalty incurred by switching between powers (example: vampire powers -> stand). By default it is designed to make you focus on one or the other to make pvp less sweaty.
config.sba.onlyStandUsersCanSeeStands.de: If you do not have a stand, this setting makes stands invisible to you like in the series.
config.sba.onlyStandUsersCanSeeVanillaGh: Makes ghost mobs in vanilla invisible without a stand (Ghasts, Vexes, and Allays). This is off by default to not change vanilla.
config.sba.renderJusticeHandsWhilePiloti: Makes justice render hands in control mode in first person.
config.sba.renderArmorOnPlayerCloneAbili: Whether or not clones from abilities like Justice's fog clones show renderer armor. Might help with mod compatibility.
config.sba.maxMirrorRendersAtOnceSetToZe: The maximum amount of mirrors that can render an entity on them. The default is very optimized for even bad pcs and will not likely impact fps, but if you have processing power to go around feel free to raise it.
config.sba.mirrorFlipsRendering.name: Mirror Flip
config.sba.mirrorFlipsRendering.desc: Whether or not the mirror flips the displayed entity like an actual mirror. By default this is off because shields invert in a bizzare way when it is on.
config.sba.renderGasSplatterOverlay.name: Gas Splatter Overlay
config.sba.renderGasSplatterOverlay.desc: Not recommended, but the mod has an ugly looking overlay for gas splatter that can probably be improved with a resource pack. It was decided that being doused with gasoline would show up with particles and that was enough, but this was left in as an option as well.
config.sba.showCreativeTextOnWorthinessA: Disable this to make worthiness arrows not say creative mode only if you want to distribute them in a pack.
config.sba.pressingAbilityKeysSummonsSta: Whether or not pressing ability keys (zxcv) summons stands.
config.sba.disableObviousExperimentalWar: Disables the Experimental warning from opening a world with modded dimensions.
config.sba.justiceFogBrightness.name: Justice Fog Brightness
config.sba.justiceFogBrightness.desc: The brightness level of the fog that justice creates. Shifts from sky color to white.
config.sba.magiciansRedTexturesMakeItEmm: Whether or not some skins for Magicians Red or potentially other stands light up in the dark like a glowsquid.
config.sba.magiciansRedLashesMakeItEmmis: Whether or not the fire lashes make Magician's Red emissive even on skins that are not emissive.
config.sba.magiciansRedRenderOnFireInFir: Whether or not being on stand fire renders the stand fire overlay in first person.
config.sba.mandomRewindShowsVisualEffect: Whether or not the visual effect of rewinding time appears on other players' screens. The ability is meant to be subtle and confusing canonically, but in the mod we didn't want people to mistake being rewound for lag or rubberbanding.
config.sba.mandomRewindAttemptsToSkipInt: Turn this off if you have a mod that makes mobs invisible after using mandom. Whether or not time rewind attempts to skip interpolation, so mobs instantly blip into their new locations instead of visually sliding really fast like endermen teleports.
config.sba.tuskUsesShootMode.name: Tusk Gun Mode
config.sba.tuskUsesShootMode.desc: Whether you  need to hold right click and then press left click, or just right click
config.sba.renderJusticeParticlesWhilePi: Fog particles can be disabled for first person rendering of justice control mode.
config.sba.renderJusticeParticlesInFirst: Justice passively emits particles by default.
config.sba.justiceFogParticlesPerTick.de: How many fog particles does justice spawn per tick?
config.sba.justiceSkinFlameParticlesPerT: Same as above but for the secret skins of Justice.
config.sba.cfhTicksPerFlameParticle.name: Hurricane Ticks Per Flame
config.sba.cfhTicksPerFlameParticle.desc: How many ticks between spawning flame particles for crossfire hurricane?
config.sba.bodyBagHoldingParticlesPerFiv: When holding a body bag, how many particles spawn on the corpses per five ticks?
config.sba.magiciansRedFirestormEmbersRa: The rate at which ember particles spawn with firestorm activated.
config.sba.opacityOfStand.name: Opacity of Stands
config.sba.opacityOfStand.desc: How clearly you see your stand idly.
config.sba.opacityWhileAttacking.name: Opacity While Attacking
config.sba.opacityWhileAttacking.desc: How clearly you see your stand while it is attacking.
config.sba.opacityOfOthers.name: Opacity of Others
config.sba.opacityOfOthers.desc: How clearly you see other peoples' stands idly.
config.sba.SoftAndWetCurrentlySelectedBu: For Soft and Wet, your client remembers what bubble is presently selected.
config.sba.TuskAct.name: Tusk Act
config.sba.TuskAct.desc: Saves your Tusk Act after you log out.
config.sba.rattFiringMode.name: Ratt Firing Mode
config.sba.rattFiringMode.desc: Ratt's Manual Firing mode. See the Power Menu for more details
config.sba.vampireVisionMode.name: Selected Vision Type
config.sba.vampireVisionMode.desc: Toggle on and off vampiric night vision. V is the hotkey for vampiric fates.
config.sba.currentPowerInventoryTab.name: Current Power Inventory Tab
config.sba.currentPowerInventoryTab.desc: Stores your last tab (fate vs stand disc tab, etc).
config.sba.mobThrowRecoilTicks.name: Player Throw Recoil
config.sba.mobThrowRecoilTicks.desc: How many ticks after throwing a player you can attack with basic punches again.
How many ticks after throwing a mob you can attack with basic punches again.
config.sba.mobPlayerThrowRecoilTicks.des: How many ticks after throwing a mob you can attack with basic punches again.
config.sba.wallPassingHitboxes.name: Some Abilities Pass Walls
config.sba.wallPassingHitboxes.desc: Some abilities in the mod like Walking Heart's heel spikes go through walls. If this poses a cheesing problem in your pack, turn this off.
config.sba.wallPassingHitboxesOnBosses.d: Some abilities in the mod like Walking Heart's heel spikes go through walls. This is a boss anti-cheese and is the above setting just purely for bosses.
config.sba.namedSBRHorseSkins.name: Named SBR Horses
config.sba.namedSBRHorseSkins.desc: Naming horses after select SBR ones changes their skins.
config.sba.skeletonFireInterval.name: Skeleton Fire Interval
config.sba.skeletonFireInterval.desc: How long in between the skeleton corpses' synchronized shots for Justice's corpse army.
config.sba.timeStopFreezesScreen.name: Screen Freeze
config.sba.timeStopFreezesScreen.desc: Whether or not time stop makes you unable to see anything happening, as the screen is frozen. This option is off by default because of the unexciting implications of seeing nothing moving for 9 seconds.
config.sba.tsStandsSeeTSTeleportAndDontF: Whether or not having a time stop seeing stand (The World, Star Platinum, or C-Moon) will allow you to see things teleport like endermen instead of blipping into a new location. If you have screen freeze on, this setting instead makes you see time stop normally.
config.sba.simpleTimeStopShader.name: Simple Shader
config.sba.simpleTimeStopShader.desc: Whether or not stopping time renders a simple shader.
config.sba.advancedTimeStopShader.name: Advanced Shader
config.sba.advancedTimeStopShader.desc: Whether or not stopping time renders a bubble shader. Overrides simple shader when on.
config.sba.alternateShaderEntry.name: Alternate Shader Entry
config.sba.alternateShaderEntry.desc: If the time stop shader does not work in your modpack, try turning this on/off, in case other mods break the other entry point. Note this with this enabled, ground lines sweep through entities, otherwise they go underneath them.
config.sba.walkingHeartMaxHits.name: Max Planted Hits
config.sba.walkingHeartMaxHits.desc: How many hits can you take in heel planted/wall walking mode before you are knocked out of that state.
config.sba.walkingHeartCooldownPerHit.de: How many cooldown ticks per hit in heel planted/wall walking mode.
config.sba.walkingHeartCooldownBase.name: Cooldown Base
config.sba.walkingHeartCooldownBase.desc: How many cooldown ticks when hit at least once in planted/wall walking mode.
config.sba.usePreciseMath.name: Use Precise Sphere Math
config.sba.usePreciseMath.desc: If you want the bubble of time stop to accurately cover the radius of the completed sphere rather than just being a simple box calculation. By default it is true because time stop prevents lots of things from ticking and saves performance as is.
config.sba.configButtonOffsetX.name: Config Button X Offset
config.sba.configButtonOffsetX.desc: Adjust the position of the ingame config. If you mess this up too badly to press the button ingame, you can change the file manually in the config folder.
config.sba.configButtonOffsetY.name: Config Button Y Offset
config.sba.configButtonOffsetY.desc: Adjust the position of the ingame config. If you mess this up too badly to press the button ingame, you can change the file manually in the config folder.
config.sba.shouldShowConfigButton.name: Show Config Button
config.sba.shouldShowConfigButton.desc: Whether or not the config button needs to be shown at all. If you are a modpack dev you will most likely want to turn this off when your pack is fully configured.
config.sba.banDirectionalBlockPlacingFai: Dungeons now loading 2 Percent has a bug that makes block placement return false even if the block places, leading stand block place/throw to infinitely item dupes. Turn this on only if you have that mod installed because it means failed placements delete the blocks instead of duping them.
config.sba.enableRoadRollerRender.name: Render Held Road Roller
config.sba.enableRoadRollerRender.desc: Disable to make it not render above your head when held.
config.sba.vampireOSTChange.name: Vampire OST
config.sba.vampireOSTChange.desc: Disable to make vampires share the game OST with regular players.
